exposure: Pregnancy after stoma formation for IBD
cohort: Pregnant women with IBD who had stomas formed prior to their pregnancies, from 15 UK hospitals since 2014.
finding: There was a high rate of cesarean section (73%) in women with a stoma compared to the national rate, and a high rate of serious stoma complications (24%).
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was 73%, with 44 elective and 14 emergency cesareans.
